name: Pass The Dutchie
summary:
Pass The Dutchie is a social VR hangout for groups, clans and competitive teams. Kick back with your crew in a 90s basement, then head down to the bunker to plan your next comp match together.

HANG OUT
- Up to 20 players in a room, with voice chat that stays in the room you're in
- Join the public basement or make your own server: public, or private with a 4-digit join code for your group only
- Two card tables with a full deck, chips, an UNO-style deck and a dealer screen with 25 games and their rules
- A
